title: I AI-slopped a GLSL to Godot shader converter
author: NickLeProf
selftext:
I was tired of manually converting GLSL shaders from Shadertoy (and other sources) to Godot's shader language, so I asked Claude if it was possible to parse regular GLSL and turn it into .gdshader files.

My only requirements: use a real AST instead of regex or string replacement, and make it hostable on GitHub Pages. So here it is:

[https://www.nicolasbourre.com/glsl2godot/](https://www.nicolasbourre.com/glsl2godot/)

I'd love it if some of you could test it. If you find bugs or have ideas for improvements, just open an issue on the repo: [https://github.com/nbourre/glsl2godot/issues](https://github.com/nbourre/glsl2godot/issues)

Thanks!

PS: I take no credit, I just held the leash.
